item.title: Netflix Greenlights Vegas Casino Drama Series From ‘Billions’ Creators Brian Koppelman & David Levien; Martin Scorsese Exec Produces
item.description: Netflix is pushing a fresh stack of chips into Las Vegas. The streamer announced today that it is ordering an untitled eight-episode casino drama series from longtime gambling-world storytellers Brian Koppelman and David Levien, with Martin Scorsese on board as executive producer, reuniting the minds behind “Rounders,” “Ocean’s Thirteen,” and “Casino” for another story about the money, greed, and power humming beneath the Strip’s neon glow.
